mapper.select: SELECT id AS configId, tenant_id AS tenantId, industry_code AS industryCode, iot_alarm_config_name AS iotAlarmConfigName, iot_alarm_type AS iotAlarmType, receive_start_time AS receiveStartTime, receive_end_time AS receiveEndTime, receive_period_time AS receivePeriodTime, alarm_level AS alarmLevel, intercept_time AS interceptTime, intercept_time_unit AS interceptTimeUnit, device_groups_json AS deviceGroupsJson FROM vm_iot_alarm_config_t WHERE config_status = '1' AND delete_flag = 0

SELECT group_id AS groupId, factor_code AS factorCode, factor_name AS factorName, min_char AS minChar, min_num AS minNum, max_char AS maxChar, max_num AS maxnum, value_type AS valueType, sum_value AS sumValue, sum_value_unit AS sumValueUnit, factor_type_code AS sensorTypeCode
FROM vm_iot_alarm_factor_t WHERE delete_flag = 0
AND group_id IN
#{groupId}
